name: google-earth-engine
description: Invoke when Earth Engine, GEE, ee., or geemap is named; when work needs its server-side catalog; or when choosing Earth Engine versus local xarray or desktop processing for a large area or long archive. Covers image collections, masking, compositing, reducers, zonal statistics, time series, classification, quota-aware batching, and exports. This is an execution platform skill; combine it with remote-sensing-analysis or change-detection when those skills own the scientific method.
